### Three things need your attention

Both cannot hold. Shipped resolution favours FR-021: the `|{_QUAD}(?![0-9.])` alternative in `_EMAIL` (`src/logredact/redact.py:95`) admits an IPv4-literal domain, so `user@10.0.0.7` redacts to `[EMAIL]` and counts toward **`emails`, not `ips`**. The amendment note in `contracts/redaction-patterns.md` still matches the shipped pattern. Reversing it means deleting that one alternative and amending FR-021 plus the Edge Cases entry.

**2. "32 identifiers" is a miscount.** SC-004's own enumeration — FR-001 through FR-031 plus FR-005a, FR-007a, FR-019a, FR-030a, FR-031a — is 31 + 5 = **36**. The figure 32 appears in `spec.md` (SC-004), `plan.md`, and `tasks.md` (T035, T037). All 36 are covered, and `tests/test_requirement_coverage.py` now fails the suite if any citation is lost.
